seed_contract.screen: two paired seed identifiers from CAMPAIGN_LOCK
seed_contract.finalist_if_promoted: three paired seed identifiers from FINALIST_LOCK

scorecard_per_seed_uncached_fits.raw_sensitive_proxy_score: maximum of AUC and reversed AUC for each reader on OSF internal validation, then maximum across the two fixed readers

role_admission_preprocessing.alias_rule: S3 may alias seed slots only when admitted role files, ordered columns, preprocessing, source/export revision and access checks are exactly identical; otherwise charge two jobs

scorecard_fit_configuration.class_safe_group_repair: if fit lacks any declared task/SEX class, move smallest selection-side group containing a missing class into fit, tie by numeric unit ID, repeat; no replenishment; require nonempty selection and both SEX classes there; record move hashes/counts
scorecard_fit_configuration.reader_recovery: max(AUC,1-AUC) per reader; maximum over fixed two-reader slate

scorecard_sharing: Joint, independent, sequential, common-mask and utility-only selectors may alias the same immutable scorecard only when source, split, seed, columns, preprocessing, proxy architecture, regularization, views and fit budget match exactly.
prior_arm_slot_default_status: SKIPPED_NO_COMPATIBLE_PRIOR_IMPLEMENTATION unless a faithful implementation is named and costed before CAMPAIGN_LOCK

screen_private_custody_jobs_if_ten_runna.status: head custody implemented; calibrator and package custody require S2 callback integration before complete deployment claim; all counts are upper expansions before exact aliases

screen_attack_fit_count_status: illustrative upper expansion only; S2 must define/freeze exact attack slate, and S3 must count exact aliases and any prior-selector incompatibility before lock
prior_control_rule: Before CAMPAIGN_LOCK, identify a faithful compatible existing coalition-aware selector. If none is compatible, mark the planned prior-art slot SKIPPED_NO_COMPATIBLE_PRIOR_IMPLEMENTATION with zero fits; retain the standard task-only and shared-mask controls under their own identities. Do not invent a renamed reproduction after outcomes.
final_head_alias_rule: Share final head/calibrator/attack units only when source, role split, seed, ordered selected columns, preprocessing, initialized architecture, optimizer schedule, fitted weights, calibration law and transmitted view are exactly identical; maintain explicit arm aliases and zero duplicate fit counts.

proposed_final_head_smoke_not_locked.architecture: selected raw columns -> ReLU64 -> ReLU64 -> task logits
proposed_final_head_smoke_not_locked.early_stop: OSF_DEFENSE_FIT group-disjoint 15% split with seed+17001; class-safe move of smallest validation group containing each missing training task class, numeric unit tie; never replenish; validation natural-log NLL, patience 5, min_delta 1e-4, first minimum
proposed_final_head_smoke_not_locked.final_refit: reinitialize from same seed, train all OSF_DEFENSE_FIT for selected epoch count, deterministic per-epoch shuffle seed+30000+epoch

per_final_head_arm_seed.forward_view_construction_rule: ATTACK_FIT_NEW and INNER_SELECTION complete local/coalition views are currently built in memory in their respective forward slots; any later private on-disk serialization and hashing must be named and charged separately by S2/S3 before the science seal
per_final_head_arm_seed.training_forward_passes: count actual batches and epochs separately for selection-fit, internal validation and full-role refit from locked split/selected epoch; S3 must expand before seal
per_final_head_arm_seed.fresh_attack_fits: S2 shared slate times local income, local occupation and coalition complete views; count explicitly in CAMPAIGN_LOCK

data_roles.selection_and_defense_fit: OSF_DEFENSE_FIT only; expected 15434 rows/15428 groups, S2 must verify
data_roles.calibration: CALIBRATION_HELDOUT task labels only, exact inherited membership under S2 fixed H-GLOBAL-TEMP family
data_roles.fresh_attack_fit: ATTACK_FIT_NEW SEX only; expected 4064 rows/4061 groups, S2 must verify
data_roles.screen: INNER_SELECTION task and SEX labels only for final scoring; expected 2235 rows/2234 groups, S2 must verify
embargo: old assessment person-level arrays or labels

budget_gate: S3 must time one scorecard mask fit, one final task head fit, calibration, three-view fresh attack slate and preprocessing, then expand the exact aliases and all units before campaign lock. No real-data fit is authorized by this draft.
